detection: Article or common CMS content containers and Article JSON-LD
appliesTo: Single-page articles, announcements, and policy documents
Full content text, structured tables, image URLs, and attachment links
Rendered browser pages when the application explicitly enables browser mode or fallback
notAppliesTo: Guaranteed extraction from every website or unknown layout without configuration
PDF, Word, image OCR, or attachment body extraction
Automatic traversal of paginated articles or embedded frames

requirements.api: optional: explicit endpoint and content field mapping for unknown APIs
requirements.browser: conditional: application-supplied Playwright and explicit opt-in
requirements.human: required if a CAPTCHA or slider is detected
